RECOMMEND FIX in Phase 1 — scope it to a break-glass role that is audited, not a silent bypass. Today an admin can put a banner in front of all traffic with no approval and no trace.
Three commented-out guards: popup country filter, single-active-popup, MobilePromotions targeting

Coupon expiry: fix min=tomorrow + add time granularity, or accept as debt?
RECOMMEND FIX in Phase 1 — it is a 2-line validation change and without it a coupon cannot end a same-day flash sale. Accepting it as debt means flash sales stay manual even after scheduling ships.

150KB image cap + 4-slot (desktop/mobile × EN/AR) model: carry forward or redesign?
